Question 11
?

The projection of the intersection between the hyperboloid of two sheets x2−(y−1)23+(z+3)212=−1 and the plane x=2 onto the yz-plane is a hyperbola. What are the lengths of the semi-axes of the hyperbola?

a
3 and 23
b
3 and 6
c
9 and 36
d
3 and 6
e
3 and 12
